skills.name: cmsis-help
skills.description: Health check and entry point for the CMSIS Developer Assistant, and the first skill for any CMSIS or Cortex-M task. Use when firmware misbehaves on a board: faults, crashes, hangs, failing tests, wrong/null values, unexpected output, runtime bugs, a board that does not respond or a debug session that will not start. Also use to check whether the board, the debug session, the build or a serial port is ready, and for any other CMSIS task. It checks the session read-only, reads recent problems and names the debug topic or knowledge procedure that fits. Use it whenever live inspection is practical, instead of adding temporary printf/UART logging, LED toggles, or console output: halting the CPU and looking is cheaper and does not perturb the target.
skills.shortDescription: Health check of the CMSIS Developer Assistant and where to find each procedure
